gpt2-small.shows: per-layer test/val Pearson of probe predicting behavior_margin
gpt2-small.read: higher = preference more linearly decodable at that layer; rising trend = upper layers commit

gpt2-small.shows: histogram of per-prompt behavior_margin
gpt2-small.read: mass right of 0 = model leans sycophantic; heavy left = resists. Annotated % prefer syc

gpt2-small.shows: attribution score per layer, top-k highlighted
gpt2-small.read: taller bar = layer contributes more to the probe's predicted preference

gpt2-small.shows: probe_delta by intervention method
gpt2-small.read: more negative for probe_gradient than random = attributed layers matter to the probe

gpt2-small.shows: behavior_margin_delta by intervention method
gpt2-small.read: probe_gradient separating from random = attributed layers causally shift behavior

gpt2-small.shows: effect size vs number of layers intervened
gpt2-small.read: probe-gradient curve below random = targeted layers do more per-k

gpt2-small.shows: sycophancy probe decodability vs random-label / static-feature / topic controls
gpt2-small.read: random-label ~0 = signal is real; a surface feature matching the probe = confound risk

gpt2-small.shows: behavior_margin change vs steering strength, per direction method
gpt2-small.read: steeper line = that direction controls behavior more; compare diff_of_means to regression

gpt2-small.shows: answer-flip rate vs steering strength, per direction
gpt2-small.read: higher flip rate at moderate α = more effective, interpretable control

gpt2-small.shows: per-layer decodability and causal effect on two axes
gpt2-small.read: curves tracking = decoding predicts causation; diverging = they're different layers

gpt2-small.shows: behavior_margin change when each layer is patched, with 95% CI
gpt2-small.read: bars/points with CI clear of 0 = a genuinely causal layer

gpt2-small.shows: share of prompts that changed preferred answer when each layer is patched
gpt2-small.read: taller bar = patching that layer more often flips the model's A/B choice

gpt2-small.shows: targeted syc→honest answer-flip by layer selection and intervention
gpt2-small.read: taller = more answers flipped to honest; does causal_topk (orange) beat decodable/random?

gpt2-small.shows: behavior_margin change per condition with 95% CI
gpt2-small.read: negative bars clear of 0 = real de-sycophantizing effect

gpt2-small.shows: decodability and causal effect by layer, with selected intervention layers shaded
gpt2-small.read: if orange (causal) and blue (decodable) bands sit at different layers, the two diverge

gpt2-small.shows: weirdness / repetition / QA-drop and overall side-effect score after intervention
gpt2-small.read: low bars = intervention preserves general capability; high = model disrupted

gpt2-small.shows: control vs side-effect trade-off across intervention configs
gpt2-small.read: top-left points dominate: high flip, low harm; flat/low cloud = no good lever

gpt2-small.shows: top 10 intervention configs by objective score
gpt2-small.read: longer bar = better control-vs-harm trade-off; orange=causal layers

gpt2-small.shows: answer-flip vs side-effect for additive vs projection-ablation vs mean-shift
gpt2-small.read: a point in the shaded clean zone with high flip = capability-preserving control

gpt2-small.shows: each family's best flip and the side-effect it incurs
gpt2-small.read: tall blue + short orange = clean control; tall both = disruptive control
